title: VeriContest: A Competitive-Programming Benchmark for Verifiable Code Generation
authors_zh: Zichen Xie, Mrigank Pawagi, Yuxin Liu, Aaditi Rai, Lize Shao, John Berberian Jr., Sicong Che, Wenxi Wang
paper_type_zh: Rust/Verus 形式化可验证代码生成 benchmark
best_for_zh: 需要 Verus 证明、规格生成或可验证程序合成评测数据的研究者。
one_line: VeriContest pairs 946 programming problems with Rust code, Verus specifications and proofs, and positive/negative tests to evaluate end-to-end verifiable code generation.
VeriContest 为 946 道竞赛编程题配套 Rust 代码、Verus 规格与证明以及正负测试，用于评测端到端可验证代码生成。
why: It separates ordinary code generation from specification and proof synthesis while making all stages checkable by a formal verifier.
inclusion_reason: VeriContest releases task records with formally checked Verus proofs alongside executable code and tests, yielding a strong programmatically verifiable final outcome.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Code-generation benchmarks usually use finite tests, allowing boundary errors to survive weak suites, while formal-verification benchmarks often contain small hand-written functions without competitive-programming algorithms, I/O protocols, or performance constraints. Program correctness, specification quality, and machine proof are typically evaluated separately, obscuring bottlenecks in end-to-end vericoding.

VeriContest converts 946 LeetCode and Codeforces problems into Rust/Verus tasks. Each provides a natural-language statement, formal specification, judge-accepted implementation, Verus proof, and extensive positive and negative tests. Construction combines expert seed tasks, coding-agent expansion, online-judge validation, Verus kernel checking, and counterexample-oriented specification testing, enabling separate evaluation of specification, code, proof, and complete verified generation.

现有代码生成 benchmark 多用有限测试判断程序行为，模型可能通过样例或弱测试而隐藏边界错误；形式验证 benchmark 又常给出小型手写函数，缺少真实竞赛题的算法复杂度、输入输出协议和性能要求。代码正确、规范完整和机器证明通常被分开评测，无法观察端到端 vericoding 的瓶颈。

VeriContest 将 946 道 LeetCode/Codeforces 题转换为 Rust/Verus 任务，每题同时提供自然语言描述、形式化规格、judge-accepted 实现、Verus 证明以及大量正负测试。数据构建结合专家写种子、coding agent 扩展、在线判题、Verus 内核检查和规格反例搜索，用于分别评测 spec、code、proof 与完整 verified code generation。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The main contribution is to unify functionality, efficiency, and formal proof for competitive programming in one benchmark. It contains 690 LeetCode and 256 Codeforces problems. Each record includes a Rust/Verus specification, executable program, proof, online-judge information, positive tests, and mutation-derived negative tests. The Verus compiler and proof kernel determine formal correctness, original online judges check algorithms and complexity, and Post2Exe translates postconditions into executable checks to detect incomplete specifications. The roughly 50 GB release provides hundreds of positive cases per problem on average and about ten times as many negative cases, supporting vericoding, specification generation, proof generation, and verifier-guided RL.

核心贡献是将竞赛编程的功能、效率与形式证明统一到同一 benchmark。数据含 690 道 LeetCode 和 256 道 Codeforces 题；每条记录包含 Rust/Verus 规格、可执行程序、证明、在线判题信息、正测试与由 mutation 产生的负测试。Verus 编译/证明内核判断形式正确性，原平台 judge 检查算法与复杂度，Post2Exe 将后置条件转为可执行检查并寻找不完整规格。最终数据约 50 GB，平均每题数百正例并有约十倍负例，可用于 vericoding 评测、specification generation、proof generation 和 verifier-guided RL。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Create expert seeds: Experts manually formalize 91 problems as Rust/Verus specifications, implementations, and proofs, defining allowed language features and anti-cheating constraints.
  1. Scale with an agent: A coding agent generates specifications, Rust code, and proofs from LeetCode and Codeforces problems. Tasks using unsupported features or failing within time limits are removed.
  1. Apply dual verification: Implementations must pass the original online judge and then compile and verify in Verus. Experts inspect for assume, unsafe escapes, or hard-coded answers.
  1. Test specification completeness: Verified generators produce positive tests and line coverage, while mutations create negative tests. Post2Exe executes postconditions, leading to revisions of about 60 incomplete specifications. At least two experts review records; reproduction requires fixed Verus and Rust versions, judge data, and time limits.

1. 建立专家种子： 专家手工将 91 道题写成 Rust/Verus 规格、实现和证明，规定允许的语言特性与无作弊约束。
  1. agent 扩展： coding agent 从 LeetCode/Codeforces 题生成规格、Rust 代码和证明；不支持的特性或无法在时间预算内完成的任务删除。
  1. 双重验证： 实现先通过原在线 judge，再由 Verus 编译和证明；专家检查是否使用 assume、不安全逃逸或将答案写死。
  1. 测试规格充分性： 由 verified generator 产生正测试并测行覆盖率，mutation 生成负测试；Post2Exe 执行后置条件，发现约 60 个不完整规格后修订。至少两名专家复核，复现需固定 Verus/Rust、judge 数据和时间上限。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The authors evaluate frontier models on four stages. The strongest GPT-5.5 reaches about 48.31% for specification generation, 92.18% for executable code from natural language, only 13.95% for Verus proof generation given a specification, and 5.29% for end-to-end verified code. The gap shows that ordinary code correctness does not represent formal-proof ability and that proof synthesis is the dominant bottleneck. For data quality, positive tests achieve about 99.66% average line coverage, and Post2Exe identifies and leads to fixes for 60 incomplete specifications. The benchmark clearly separates stages, but results depend on the supported Verus subset, online judges, and recent proprietary models; high test coverage still does not prove complete specifications.

作者对 frontier model 分别测试四个环节。表现最强的 GPT-5.5 在 specification generation 约 48.31%，从自然语言生成可执行代码约 92.18%，给定规格生成 Verus proof 仅 13.95%，端到端同时生成可验证代码只有 5.29%。这一落差说明普通代码正确率不能代表形式证明能力，proof synthesis 是主要瓶颈。数据质量方面，正测试平均行覆盖率约 99.66%，Post2Exe 发现并修复 60 个不完整规格。证据支持 benchmark 能区分阶段，但结果高度依赖 Verus 支持子集、在线 judge 和较新的闭源模型；测试覆盖高也不等于规格完全。

title: Novelty
新意
html: FVAPPS-style work translates programming problems into Lean theorems, often weakening original runtime and contest I/O constraints, while Verus datasets frequently use small verification examples. VeriContest preserves online judges as practical functional and complexity constraints, adds Verus specifications and kernel proofs, and actively audits weak specifications with positive and negative tests. The novelty is not the first use of Verus or contest problems, but the combination of three verification layers: judges check programs, Verus checks proofs, and Post2Exe with counterexample tests checks specification adequacy, reducing the risk of proving an incorrect or weak statement.

FVAPPS 等工作把编程题转换为 Lean theorem，通常弱化了原始运行效率和竞赛输入输出；Verus 数据集则多来自小型验证程序。VeriContest 的变化是保留在线 judge 作为现实功能/复杂度约束，同时增加 Verus specification 和 proof kernel，并用正负测试主动审计 specification 是否过弱。新意不在首次使用 Verus 或竞赛题，而在三个 verifier 的组合：judge 检查程序、Verus 检查证明、Post2Exe/反例测试检查规格，从而避免“证明了一个错误或过弱命题”。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Language subset: Many tasks involving floating point, complex data structures, concurrency, or unsupported Verus features are filtered. The 946 tasks are not an unbiased sample of competitions and cannot represent full Rust or general systems code.
  1. Generation and exposure: Expansion uses agents such as GPT-5.3-Codex and public contest solutions, while evaluated models may have seen original problems or related solutions. Reuse requires source-, date-, and template-aware deduplication and reporting of expert versus agent-generated proportions.
  1. Specification adequacy: Post2Exe covers only translatable postconditions, leaving roughly 17% without automatic conversion. Hundreds of tests and 99.66% line coverage still do not prove semantic completeness. High-risk uses need expert and formal refinement audits.

1. 语言子集： 大量浮点、复杂数据结构、并发或 Verus 不支持特性的题被过滤，946 题不是原竞赛分布的无偏样本。结果不能外推到完整 Rust 或一般系统代码。
  1. 生成与暴露： 扩展阶段使用 GPT-5.3-Codex 等 agent 和公开竞赛解法，后续评测模型可能见过原题或相关 solution。需按来源、发布日期和模板去重，并报告专家种子与 agent 生成比例。
  1. 规格充分性： Post2Exe 只覆盖可翻译后置条件，约 17% 情况不能自动转换；数百测试和 99.66% 行覆盖也无法证明语义完备。高风险任务仍需专家和形式化 refinement 审计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Stage-wise vericoding evaluation: Separately evaluate natural language to specification, natural language to code, specification to proof, and end-to-end generation under fixed Verus versions, time limits, and retry counts.
  1. RLVR: Build hierarchical rewards from online judges, Verus proofs, and negative tests: compile, pass functional tests, prove, and finally survive specification counterexamples. Rewarding only Verus success invites exploitation of weak specifications.
  1. Specification training: Train specification generators or critics from positive cases, mutation negatives, and Post2Exe outcomes. For languages other than Rust/Verus, tasks with external state, or unavailable judges, the benchmark provides a method reference rather than a directly reusable verifier.

1. 分阶段 vericoding 评测： 分别测试 NL→spec、NL→code、spec→proof 和 end-to-end，统一 Verus 版本、时间与重试次数，避免只报告最终低分而无法定位瓶颈。
  1. RLVR： 将在线 judge、Verus proof 和负测试合成分层 reward：先编译、再功能通过、再证明、最后规格反例检查；不得只奖励 verus 成功，否则模型可能利用弱 specification。
  1. 规格训练： 用正例、mutation 负例和 Post2Exe 结果训练 spec generator 或 critic。若目标语言不是 Rust/Verus、任务需要外部状态或无法访问 judge，该 benchmark 只能提供方法参考，不能直接充当 verifier。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: VeriContest pairs 946 contest problems with Rust/Verus specifications, implementations, proofs, and positive and negative tests for end-to-end vericoding.
  1. Method takeaway: Expert seeds, agent expansion, online judges, the Verus kernel, and Post2Exe counterexample checks jointly determine quality.
  1. Data takeaway: It contains 690 LeetCode and 256 Codeforces problems and roughly 50 GB of specifications, code, proofs, judge information, and tests.
  1. Evidence anchor: GPT-5.5 reaches 92.18% for code, 13.95% for proof, and only 5.29% end to end, making proof generation the main bottleneck.
  1. Reuse decision: It suits verified-code evaluation and hierarchical RLVR. Problem exposure and weak specifications require joint judge, proof, and counterexample checks.

1. 一句话定位： VeriContest 将 946 道竞赛题配成 Rust/Verus 规格、实现、证明与正负测试，评测端到端 vericoding。
  1. 方法抓手： 专家种子、agent 扩展、在线 judge、Verus 内核和 Post2Exe 反例检查共同决定数据质量。
  1. 数据抓手： 690 LeetCode + 256 Codeforces，约 50 GB；每题有规格、代码、proof、judge 信息和大量测试。
  1. 证据锚点： GPT-5.5 的 code 为 92.18%、proof 为 13.95%、end-to-end 仅 5.29%，证明阶段最难。
  1. 复用决定： 适合形式代码评测与分层 RLVR；最大风险是题目暴露和弱规格，必须联合 judge、proof 与反例测试。
